questions.q: The graph's CFGGuider has cfg 1.0. What does the negative prompt do?
options: Nothing: at 1 the conditional result is used alone, and the negative pass is skipped
It is subtracted at half strength
It sets the frame rate
It selects the noise list
questions.answer: Nothing: at 1 the conditional result is used alone, and the negative pass is skipped
questions.why: sampling_function sets the unconditional to None when cond_scale is close to 1, so that pass is never run.

questions.q: What does frame_rate on LTXVConditioning do beyond being a label?
options: The model divides time coordinates by it, so it sets how far apart frames are in seconds
It sets how fast the file plays
It changes the number of frames
Nothing, it is ignored by the model
questions.answer: The model divides time coordinates by it, so it sets how far apart frames are in seconds
questions.why: _prepare_positional_embeddings multiplies the time coordinate by 1 / frame_rate. Playback speed is CreateVideo's fps, a separate number.

questions.q: How many model calls does the graph's sampling take?
options: 8: nine sigmas make 8 steps, and CFG 1 means one call per step
9, one per sigma
16, two per step
20, the usual default
questions.answer: 8: nine sigmas make 8 steps, and CFG 1 means one call per step
questions.why: euler_ancestral makes one call per step, and the list has 8 intervals.

questions.q: The temporal_size is 64 and the temporal overlap 8 in VAEDecodeTiled. What does the VAE receive?
options: Tiles of 8 latent frames, overlapping by 1, since LTX's temporal factor is 8
Tiles of 64 latent frames, overlapping by 8
One tile of 64 pixels
8 tiles in total
questions.answer: Tiles of 8 latent frames, overlapping by 1, since LTX's temporal factor is 8
questions.why: decode divides both by vae.temporal_compression_decode(), so 64 // 8 = 8, and 8 // 8 = 1.

questions.q: Why does LTXVEmptyLatentAudio take the audio VAE as an input?
options: It reads the channel count, the frequency bins and latents per second from it
To decode audio as the latent is created
To load the vocoder early
It uses it to set the seed
questions.answer: It reads the channel count, the frequency bins and latents per second from it
questions.why: The node reads audio_vae.latent_channels and first_stage_model.latent_frequency_bins, and calls num_of_latents_from_frames.
